content.summary: P12 rechecks the complete implementation after correspondence changes, replays all 45 stored P8 comparisons, and exports unresolved definitions for review without model calls. The pre-execution audit found and repaired an inherited out-of-domain fallback defect, with three failing reproductions followed by fifteen passing formal-comparator tests.
findings: The baseline is frozen P8 attempt 01: 21 and 24 recorded comparisons on 24EC50 and 23EC46. Do not select easier pairs or infer accuracy from match counts. Hash-check the source packet, investigation, report and archive before and after replay.

There are no extra exact-metadata alias opportunities in these saved nodes. Preserve all 33 incomparable pairs and export full source, definitions, assumptions, output expressions and review questions. Zero extra automatic matches is expected, not a failure to improve a metric.

The explicitly preselected 24EC50 correspondence is hypothetical. It needs assumptions about the covered submission, event date and channel. The date-aware expressions have no approved solver domain; finite probes cannot establish equivalence.

domain-fallback-before.xml retains three failures: unresolved bounded checks previously returned differences outside the declared domain. The guard now preserves UNKNOWN or UNSUPPORTED, with no unconstrained probes. domain-fallback-after.xml records all fifteen comparator tests passing. Automatic complete Boolean domains retain safe finite fallback and never infer equivalence from it.

P10 and P11 passed their focused tests. Full regression is required against the exact current input hashes, including original-Java replay, role separation, source invalidation, concurrent rejection and history portability.

Use the approved trusted fixed supervisor, bounded to 2700 seconds per command and six failed attempts. Do not edit accepted inputs during execution. Any failure requires diagnosis and an executed repair before re-review and retry.

No new provider calls, independent human decisions, statistical ranking, legal-accuracy estimate or bank release is included. The ledger remains 41 of 100 and current review packets are candidate-exposed, not blind reference annotations.
